title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD WAITS FOR THE BACKPACK
why: Seen on the 4K Undercroft backpack screenshot of 2026-10-08: with the what is new card still up, opening the backpack laid the bag over the card and its lines read through the bag panel, two layers of text on top of each other. While the backpack is open the card now waits; it is back when the bag closes, until you walk it off as before.
now: Opening the backpack in the Undercroft no longer shows the what is new card through it.
